analyst.summary: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals runs a growing multi-specialty hospital chain across Mumbai, Pune, Indore and Dombivli, benefiting from India's structurally rising demand for private tertiary healthcare. Growth has been strong over the medium term, but the most recent quarter showed profit down 24% year-on-year and a real margin compression - not yet explained by any specific disclosed cause, though new-capacity ramp-up costs are a common reason in this industry. At around 53-55x earnings, the stock isn't priced to absorb further quarters like this without a re-rating risk. We rate it a Hold.
